Two views of one partition

A treemap tile and a sunburst arc are both exactly one mark per row, so switching between them is a shape change rather than a redraw: each rectangle unrolls into the arc that holds the same team, and back. The sunburst adds the level a treemap cannot show, the parent rings, which sweep in behind the leaves.
